module: Node "Random Quaternion" (repeat_instant, casino icon). Provides a random quaternion every frame. Inputs (degrees, hidden/fixed): xMin/xMaxAngle (0, 0), yMin/yMaxAngle (0, 0), zMin/zMaxAngle (0, 360). Output: quaternion (table {x,y,z,w}). By default: random rotation around the Z axis only.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

work.desc: Draws a random angle per axis between min and max (converted to radians), composes the X then Y then Z rotations via quatFromEuler and writes the quaternion.
